t: Plastic fixing is solely made of high quality nylon. This means that the plug is particularly robust during installation and ensures permanent safety. The pre-sorted kit is therefore ideally suited to fitting mirrors. Installation-friendly DuoPower universal plug for use in solid, hollow and panel building materials. Simple insertion due to the ease of pushing in the plug. Anti-rotation lock prevents rotation in the drill hole for a high degree of safety during installation. Can also be used on signs and panels. For use in all solid and hollow building materials including concrete, brick and plasterboard.
b: Contents: Spring-Tensioned Metal Brackets (2), Fixed Metal Brackets (2), Screws (4) & Nylon Plugs 6mm (4)
